description: [RETIRED] NCMT Substation Generation Connection Capacity (WP-050) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Western Power. This Dataset has been retired - please refer to contact details for any additional information. This layer displays indicative information provided to assist stakeholders and customers to visualise the ability of the SWIS (as it currently exists) to connect extra mid sized generation including renewable energy projects. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Western Power. Its tags are 2022 data, NCMT, capacity, electric, generation. It offers 1 resource(s) in shp. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
